name: Fire Hand
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance Yes

DESCRIPTION

Your hand is imbued with magical power that causes it to burst into flame when touched to a creature. This spell deals 1d6 fire damage upon making a successful melee touch attack.
